app_info.subtitle: Only a granted change proceeds
app_info.description: Signed, offline-verifiable authorization for AI-agent contract changes. Call preflight_change_set before merge, deploy, publish, or tool registration when a contract artifact changed. Branch only on execution_action. verify_receipt checks a receipt you already hold. get_decision_details looks up a past decision. Only a granted change can proceed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a signed decision envelope. It does not merge, deploy, or write the caller's repository.
justifications.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's CodeRifts tenant and the artifacts they submit. It does not search the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: No delete, overwrite, or irreversible side effect on the caller's systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Cryptographic and lifecycle check of a receipt the caller already holds.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates on the submitted token and stated intent, not an open-ended crawl.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not revoke, mutate, or consume the caller's artifacts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lookup of a past decision by id or fingerprint.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tenant-scoped lookup, not public web access.

test_cases.description: Authorize-mode preflight of an OpenAPI change before merge.
test_cases.user_prompt: Preflight this OpenAPI before/after for merge (authorize).
test_cases.expected_output: execution_action is one of CONTINUE, CONTINUE_WITH_MONITORING, REQUEST_APPROVAL, STOP; signed envelope; may_execute only when the action permits.

test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze this GraphQL change; I am not merging yet.
test_cases.expected_output: preflight_mode=analyze; may_execute is false; no grant.

test_cases.description: Verify a receipt the caller already holds.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify this receipt token before deploy.
test_cases.expected_output: valid vs currently_authorized are separate fields; verification does not replace preflight for a new change set.

test_cases.description: Look up a past decision by id.
test_cases.expected_output: Tenant-scoped decision record for the given id or fingerprint.

test_cases.description: Complete two-artifact change set, authorize merge.
test_cases.user_prompt: Complete change set of two OpenAPI files, authorize merge.
test_cases.expected_output: Both artifacts appear in artifacts[]; not a one-file subset.

negative_test_cases.description: Documentation-only change must not call preflight.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The skill does not call a CodeRifts tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Fail closed on an unrecognised permission field.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Treat decision=ALLOW as permission even if execution_action is STOP.

negative_test_cases.description: A merge receipt does not authorize a deploy.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reuse a merge receipt to authorize a deploy.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refusal or a new preflight with context.operation=deploy.
